PM Modi's Indo-Pacific visits focus on expanding India's regional ties

Prime Minister Modi's recent foreign visits to the Indo-Pacific region are highlighted as a strategic move to strengthen India's partnerships and influence. The visits aim to build diverse bilateral ties, focusing on maritime security and defense cooperation, as global powers like China and the US reshape the region. This engagement seeks to expand India's defense arc and diplomatic presence in the Indo-Pacific.
